simple.meaning: תַּחְתִּי (tachtîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “lowermost ; as noun (feminine plural) the depths (figuratively, a pit , the womb ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 19 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 6:16. Its contexts include land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּחְתִּי (H8482).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: lowermost ; as noun (feminine plural) the depths (figuratively, a pit , the womb )
definitions.full: H8482. tachti תַּחְתִּי adjective and substantive lower, lowest (places): — feminine singular תַּחָתִּיָּה Psa 86:13 , תַּחְתִּית Exod 19:17 +; masculine plural תַּחְתִּיִּם Gen 6:16 ; feminine plural תַּחְתִיּוֺת Psa 63:10 +; — Exod 19:17 הָהָר בְּחַחְתִּית ויתיצבו in the lower part of the mountain, Judg 1:15 = Josh 15:19 (so read here with ᵐ5 MSS ᵑ9 ᵑ7 ᵑ6 for תַּחְתִּיּוֺת גֻּלֹּת ) תַּחְתִּית גֻּלַּת אֵת the lower spring, Job 41:16 תַּחְתִּית כְּמֶּלַח like the lower mill-stone, Gen 6:16 (P) תַּחְתִּיִּם = lower stories ; of Sh®°ôl , Deut 32:22 תַּחְתַּית שְׁאוֺל עַד to the lowest Sh®°ôl , Psa 86:13 ׳מִשְּׁ תַּחְתִּיָּה , so תַּחְתִּית אֶרֶץ the lowest earth (or land) i.e. Sh., Ezek 31:14 , 16 , 18 , תַּחְתִיּוֺת אֶרֶץ the land of lowest places 26:20 ; 32:18 , 24 , תַּחְתִיּוֺת בּוֺר the pit of lowest places Lam 3:55 ; Psa 88:7 , הָאָרֶץ תֵּחְתִיּוֺת 63:10 (+ perhaps 71:20 ) the lowest places of the earth, ׳תּ אֶרֶץ Isa 44:23 , and figurative of the dark and hidden interior of the womb Psa 139:15 . — Neh 4:7 לַמָּקוֺם מִתַּחְתִיּוֺת וָאַעֲמִיד and I set ( ᵐ5 L and they stood ) at parts below ( מִן as in לְ מִחַחַת ) the place (where they were to work), so Ke Gu, but text perhaps corrupt (Berthol Sgf).
